## Rocca-S design and KDDI reference implementation

The local Go / AES-NI implementation follows draft-nakano-rocca-s-06 and
was cross-checked against https://github.com/yt-nakano/rocca-s. The archived C
implementation is used only by the offline vector generator, never linked into
the gateway. The reference and derived validation material retain this notice.

## Locked QUIC source

The existing github.com/sagernet/quic-go v0.61.0-sing-box-mod.7 dependency is now delivered in `pkg/hyrakenquic/` through the GhostX module replace. Its complete MIT license is retained in `pkg/hyrakenquic/LICENSE`; `UPSTREAM-SHA256SUMS` preserves the original source inventory. The local ACK-only recovery patch and added regression test are described in `pkg/hyrakenquic/README.loft.md`. Business continues to use its separate private fork.
